vocabulary.definition: to let the air out of something; to take the energy or force out of something
vocabulary.example: After losing the match, the team's spirits were deflated.

vocabulary.definition: arguing over things that aren't very important
vocabulary.example: The siblings were bickering over who should sit in the front seat of the car.

vocabulary.definition: feeling tense because you are nervous or worried
vocabulary.example: The suspenseful movie had me on edge throughout the entire film.

vocabulary.definition: a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to something to which it is not literally applicable
vocabulary.example: Her smile was a metaphor for sunshine, brightening up the room.

vocabulary.definition: a disagreement or argument about something important
vocabulary.example: The two countries are in a dispute over the ownership of the island.

vocabulary.definition: a state of dissatisfaction, disturbance, and agitation in a society or group of people
vocabulary.example: The political unrest in the region led to protests and demonstrations.
